title: The Goat in the Boat
lines: Meg had a goat with a black coat.
The goat got in a small red boat.
The boat went slow past a big rock.
A crow sat on the back of the boat.
The goat got up to blow at it.
The boat did tip and the goat fell in.
Meg had to throw a rope to it.
The goat swam slow to the rope.
The wet goat sat on the road and shivered.
Meg rubs the goat with a rag.
The coat is dry and the goat naps.

questions.listenFor: The goat stood up to blow at the crow. The crow itself did not tip the boat, so listen for the goat standing.

questions.ask: How did Meg get the goat back?
questions.listenFor: She threw a rope, and the goat swam slowly to it. Two steps, so let them reread if they only get one.

questions.ask: Do you think the goat will get back in the boat? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason from the story, like it got wet and cold, or it liked the slow ride.
